about: firstrun3 2026-11-18: variant_select_1p for a ROM-only install. The 1999 Undertaker (0x000A) is an added Superstar (roster option taker99): without the built-in extras (a first start with only the No Mercy ROM) no added Superstar is in (logic.c arcade_roster_opt), so the Undertaker's box holds his own four Types only and variant_select_1p can't find 0x000A (its pick returns 'not there' and the cursor stays on The Rock). Here: one player's Versus (qa_versus) with qa_variant 1 and a tour of 4 (qa_variant_tour) -- C-right x4 (Undertaker Type 2, 3, 4, 1), C-left (Type 4), C-right (Type 1) -- then on to his Type 2 and A; the CPU's pick on controller 1: the Undertaker's Type 4. The match: the Undertaker (Type 2) vs the Undertaker (Type 4). The 1999 Undertaker is never under the cursor. state.csv bs_tries = the select's Superstar under the cursor | costume << 16 | 1 << 24; bs_grabs / bs_step = picks 1 and 2 (ID | costume << 16)

expect.name: the 1999 Undertaker never under the cursor (an added Superstar: not in without the built-in extras)
player 1 picked the Undertaker, his Type 2
the CPU's pick: the Undertaker, Type 4
the match: 0x0003 costume 1 (player 1) vs 0x0003 costume 3 (CPU)
expect.check: mode == -2 and match_frames != 0xFFFF and match_frames > 120 and s0_id == 0x0003 and s0_costume == 1 and s0_pad == 1 and s1_id == 0x0003 and s1_costume == 3 and s1_pad == 0
